statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail risk is low with no tradable session in progress.
recommendation: Tail remains well below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping stays at EA_ON for NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The 22:00 UTC futures reopen and Monday's 13:30 UTC US cash open are the evidence checkpoints at which the conditional allowance is either confirmed or retired. headline: Weekend halt keeps Tail low while a 5% ten-year and $100 crude hold Stress moderate
body: The last cash session was Friday 18 September, when the Nasdaq-100 closed at 29,644.17, up 197.17 points or 0.67%, in a 29,371.89-29,647.80 range, with VIX at 14.81. That close sat near the session high, but it coincided with a very large quarterly expiry and the Nasdaq-100 rebalance that more than doubled SpaceX's index weight, so it is treated as expiry mechanics rather than directional evidence. The macro backdrop is unusually loaded: the FOMC raised its target range 25 basis points to 3.75-4.00% on 16 September, the first increase in more than three years, the ten-year Treasury yield is around 5.01% after trading above 5% intraweek for the first time since July 2007, and crude remains near $100 WTI and $104 Brent with Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline shut since 11 September. Equities have nonetheless absorbed that backdrop, and Friday saw crude ease as Saudi exports were rerouted through the Strait of Hormuz. CME Globex is halted until 22:00 UTC, so no live NQ price path is observable and no persistent one-way structure can be established. Tail therefore stays low. Stress is moderate and reflects the rate, energy and geopolitical backdrop rather than any observed price path. The conditional risk is concentrated at the Sunday reopen, where thin liquidity could extend a weekend gap before two-way flow returns, and secondarily at Monday's US cash open.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours the published Claude assessment was continuously green with the EA_ON mapping and a normal dominant mode. Tail held in a narrow 4-5 range, confirming that no persistent one-way structure was identified at any point. Stress drifted up from 23-24 during Friday's late US session and the Saturday hours to 30-31 through Sunday, tracking the rate and energy backdrop rather than any observed price path, while confidence stayed in a 72-76 band on consistent evidence quality.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours divide into three phases. Six further halted hours carry Tail at 5-7, where risk is informational only. The 22:00 UTC Globex reopen opens a narrow danger window to 01:00 UTC, with Tail conditionally raised to 11-13 for thin-liquidity gap-and-extend risk; this is an allowance for an unobserved path and would decay quickly on an orderly reopen with visible retracement. Asian and European hours then normalise toward Tail 9-10 on a light Monday calendar, before a secondary conditional peak of 12-13 around the 13:30 UTC US cash open. Every slot maps to EA_ON, and Stress stays moderate at 33-44 throughout on the unchanged 5% yield, $100 crude and hawkish Fed backdrop.
